not_qualified: No Godot/GPU/native build was run while authoring this stand; compile-only delivery does not qualify runtime behavior.
No FPS, frame-time or physical VRAM result; texture/storage readbacks serialize these correctness probes.
Opaque ordering and matching pipeline keys are derived from pinned native source, material priority and mesh local indices; no native pipeline RID or GPU order instrumentation.
Logical plateau uses RD GetMemoryUsage(Buffers): eight warmup cycles and twenty-four measured cycles, exact zero growth allowance. It is not physical VRAM or a sustained production guarantee.
Frame-delay pacing is not a GPU fence API. Explicit texture/storage readbacks complete before caller-owned storage is released.
Ordinary mesh/particle interference, pass exclusions, shadows, temporal/E8 history, transparency, XR and other backends are deferred.
Fresh process per case is required; bounded native warning state is not shared across cases.
